name: nudges
description: Suggests the right command at the right moment above the prompt, with a one-click Run: ship-check after a commit or push, next-part on a clean project, finishing old uncommitted work, and in the Work profile only, the week's manager update on Friday afternoon.

workFridayUpdate.title: Friday update in Work
workFridayUpdate.description: In Work sessions (WSOS_PROFILE=work), suggest /manager-update on Friday from 15:00. Personal sessions never get it. Turn off if a Cowork schedule writes the update instead.
